_README: 1. Copy posts/_template.html to posts/your-post-name.html and write in it.
2. Add an entry to the 'posts' list below, newest first.
'url' is the path to the file, e.g. 'posts/your-post-name.html'
'kicker' is an optional small label - a place, a subject, a mood.
Leave it out entirely if you prefer. There are deliberately no dates.
An empty list is fine. The page says so gracefully and does not look broken.
A blog with one post should look as deliberate as a blog with forty.
